verdict.rationale: Pigment is an AI-enabled SaaS planning platform, so a training opt-out or no-training guarantee is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never addresses whether customer data is used to train AI models. Data residency, access rights, and admin approval of which assistants connect are adjacent controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
